description: NEEDS A KEY: mint one at https://nittim.com/keys. Records that a finding from a prior audit is wrong (stance:'dispute') or genuinely real (stance:'confirm'), backed by evidence from the repo. Free. A SIGNAL for owner triage — it never changes the audit's scores, verdict or stored report on its own. The finding is identified by its findingKey (from the digest), or by its exact dimension and title.

auditId.description: The audit UUID, from its report link.

dimension.description: The finding's dimension, e.g. 'security' — required if findingKey is omitted.

evidence.description: What you can see in the repo that supports your stance.

explanation.description: Why this finding is wrong or confirmed real, in your own words.

file.description: The file path your evidence points to.

snippet.description: A short excerpt of the actual code supporting your stance.

findingKey.description: The finding's stable key from the digest, if you have it (preferred over dimension+title).

stance.description: 'dispute' = this finding is wrong. 'confirm' = this finding is genuinely real.

title.description: The finding's exact title — required if findingKey is omitted.

name: dispute_finding
title: Dispute or Confirm a Finding
